description.zh: 写代码时常用的一组：子代理代码审查、MCP 连接管理、仓库架构图，外加可选的危险命令护栏。
description.en: For day-to-day coding: sub-agent code review, MCP connection management, repository architecture diagrams, plus an optional destructive-command guard.

why.zh: /review 用独立子代理审查改动
why.en: /review runs an independent sub-agent over your changes

why.zh: 可视化管理 MCP 服务器连接
从仓库生成可交互的架构图、时序图
why.en: Generate interactive architecture and sequence diagrams from a repo

why.zh: 在执行前拦截 rm -rf、git reset --hard 等破坏性命令
why.en: Blocks destructive commands such as rm -rf and git reset --hard before they run
